candidates.name: Get-Uptime
verified_facts: Get-Uptime returns elapsed time since the operating system last started
The Since parameter returns the date and time of the last boot
semantic_limits: System uptime does not prove the canonical runner process or task is alive

candidates.name: Win32_OperatingSystem
verified_facts: LastBootUpTime can be recorded independently of runner heartbeat timestamps
semantic_limits: A boot timestamp alone does not establish runner ownership or receipt freshness

candidates.name: Get-Service
verified_facts: Get-Service returns service objects including running and stopped services
Without parameters it reads local Windows services
semantic_limits: Service state is supporting host evidence and does not replace canonical process and command-line ownership checks

candidates.name: Resolve-DnsName
verified_facts: Resolve-DnsName performs a DNS query for a specified name
DnsOnly restricts resolution to the DNS protocol
semantic_limits: Successful DNS resolution does not prove TCP, TLS, HTTP, Git authentication or repository write access

candidates.name: Test-NetConnection
verified_facts: Test-NetConnection provides connection diagnostics including TCP tests and route information
A remote port can be tested explicitly
semantic_limits: A successful TCP test is not application-level proof and does not prove Git push or source download succeeded

candidates.name: Get-Item
verified_facts: Get-Item retrieves the item at a specified location
File-system item output exposes metadata including LastWriteTime and Length
semantic_limits: File metadata must be combined with JSON validity, identity fields and SHA-256; timestamps alone are not authenticity proof

candidates.name: Get-Date
verified_facts: Get-Date returns a DateTime object for the current or specified date and time
AsUTC converts a date value to the equivalent UTC time
semantic_limits: Local system time may be inaccurate; UTC formatting does not itself prove clock synchronization
